spec.title: Adapters preventing a complete view · logs
spec.description: Adapter resolution problems recorded in existing ClickHouse logs. An unconfigured adapter can leave the target scan incomplete and prevent authoritative state publication. Expected skips for another authorized signer are excluded. Counts are retained log observations; the same adapter may appear on every refresh. Choose the Logs datasource when importing.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT concat('adapter: ', JSONExtractString(Body, 'adapter')) AS Adapter,
  if(JSONExtractString(Body, 'msg') = 'skipping adapter: not configured on-chain', 'Adapter not configured', 'Adapter resolution failed') AS Problem,
  count() AS Observations
FROM logs.otel_logs_k8s
WHERE Timestamp >= $__fromTime AND Timestamp <= $__toTime
  AND Namespace = ${namespace:singlequote}
  AND ServiceName = 'vault-solver-3f'
  AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'solver') = '3f-bridge-facilitator'
  AND JSONExtractString(Body, 'msg') IN ('skipping adapter: not configured on-chain', 'skipping adapter: resolution failed')
GROUP BY Adapter, Problem ORDER BY Observations DESC LIMIT 50

spec.title: Since last successful redemption
spec.description: Time since the latest successful operation whose timestamp is visible in the selected period. An initialized zero timestamp means no success has been observed; an absent series remains unavailable. Yellow after 1 hour and red after 24 hours without success; this activity warning can also reflect lack of demand.

spec.title: Submitted offer amounts · selected period
spec.description: Observed counter increases during the selected period, separated by token and amount kind. Values are atomic token units; token decimals and prices are not exported with this metric. Do not sum different tokens or interpret planned surplus / expected yield as realized profit. First nonzero samples can be absent from increases. These are submitted offers, not confirmed loans. Retained counter peaks are available in the collapsed cumulative diagnostics section.

spec.title: Redemptions over time
spec.description: Redeemed request observations per second; one transaction can redeem several requests.

spec.title: Offer submission outcomes over time
spec.description: Offer API submissions per second; successful submission does not prove a loan was taken.

spec.title: Transaction outcomes over time
spec.description: Terminal logical transaction outcomes per second. Failed submissions without receipts do not contribute receipt fees.

spec.title: Transaction fee rate
spec.description: Observed receipt fee increases in ETH per second, grouped by transaction outcome. Missing receipt prices or an absent initial scrape can undercount fees.

spec.title: Submitted offer amounts · retained counter peaks
